cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(test_package CXX)

# E096: Explicitly set C++ standard for OHOS compatibility
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

enable_testing()

# Find librevenge package (generated by CMakeDeps)
find_package(librevenge REQUIRED CONFIG)

add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME} test_package.cpp)

# Link against librevenge libraries
target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} librevenge::librevenge)

# R34: test must actually call the library API
add_test(NAME librevenge_api_test COMMAND ${PROJECT_NAME})
